_help: Act 4, the night attack. Eleanor speaks if she's in the party, else you decide alone. With recognized_bandits you name them as the men from before. Sets night_choice to barricade / americans / germans; the end node id says the same (end_barricade, end_americans, end_germans).

eleanor_alarm.speaker: eleanor
eleanor_alarm.line: Gunfire! They're at every camp at once. The Americans, the Germans... There are dozens of them out there!

alone_alarm.speaker: player
alone_alarm.line: Gunfire, from every side of the ruins at once. Dozens of them.

same_men.speaker: player
same_men.line: Those are the same men from before. The town, the boat... They've been following us all the way here.

choices.label: Barricade the camp
choices.line: Everyone behind the wall. We hold here and let the others fight their own battles.

choices.label: Help the Americans
choices.line: Whitfield's camp is closest. Grab your rifles, we're going over there!

choices.label: Help the Germans
choices.line: Adler's people won't last without help. With me, to the German camp!

eleanor_barricade.speaker: eleanor
eleanor_barricade.line: They'll be slaughtered out there... No. You're right. Keep your heads down, everyone!

eleanor_americans.speaker: eleanor
eleanor_americans.line: Then go! I'll be right behind you.

eleanor_germans.speaker: eleanor
eleanor_germans.line: The Professor's papers... and his people. Go, quickly!

alone_decide.speaker: player
alone_decide.line: No time to think it over.

choices.label: Barricade the camp
choices.line: Hold here. Let the others look after themselves.
